Director of Supply Chain

Job ID
2201
Location
US-ID-Boise

Overview

Pinecrest Health is a regional health system with four hospitals and twenty clinics. The Director of Supply Chain leads purchasing, inventory, and distribution for every site, and reports to the Vice President of Operations. This is a hands-on role for someone who has run a hospital supply chain through shortages and recalls and kept clinicians stocked the whole time.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of buyers, analysts, and warehouse supervisors across four hospitals and twenty clinics.
  • Own the annual supply budget, vendor contracts, and the group purchasing relationship.
  • Build a recall and shortage playbook that clinical leaders trust and actually use.
  • Report monthly on spend, fill rate, and stockouts to the executive team.

Qualifications

Ten years in supply chain, five of them leading teams, ideally in a hospital or health system. Comfortable with an enterprise resource planning system and with explaining tradeoffs to physicians, nurses, and finance partners in plain language.
